newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Fleming starts two Mexico firms.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Fleming starts two Mexico firms.

text.p: --Robert Fleming initiated coverage of two Mexican construction companies.
--Corporacion GEO started at long-term buy and Consorcio ARA started at buy.

--Analysts Dan McGoey and Ben Uglow say Mexico's affordable housing segment to receive increased support from Mexican government and multilateral institutions in form of discounted mortgages and increased financing availability.
--Better marketing and increase in personal debt capacity seen boosting both GEO and ARA.
--ARA seen doubling number of homes sold between 1996 and 1998.
--GEO shares predicted to rise steadily in 1997 after climbing 67 percent in 1996 (41 percent relative to Mexican bolsa).
